description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity 'AccelerometerPlayActivity' that demonstrates use of accelerometer sensors to simulate particles on a virtual tilted surface, including rendering with bitmaps and handling sensor events.

classes.name: AccelerometerPlayActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the life cycle and sensor interactions for the accelerometer-based particle simulation.

classes.name: SimulationView
classes.description: Inner class extending View that handles rendering, sensor event processing, and simulation of particles affected by accelerometer data.

classes.name: ParticleSystem
classes.description: Inner class managing a collection of particles, updating their positions using Verlet integration, and resolving collisions.

classes.name: Particle
classes.description: Represents individual particles with position, previous position, acceleration, and friction properties, including physics computations and collision resolution.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor manager, power manager, wake lock, and sets up the simulation view when activity is created.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Acquires wake lock and starts sensor listening and simulation when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops sensor listening, simulation, and releases wake lock when activity pauses.

methods.name: startSimulation
methods.description: Registers sensor listener for accelerometer data at UI delay rate.

methods.name: stopSimulation
methods.description: Unregisters the sensor listener to stop receiving accelerometer updates.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles accelerometer events, adjusts coordinates for device orientation, and updates sensor timestamp.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background and particles on canvas based on processed sensor data, including coordinate transformations.

methods.name: computePhysics
methods.description: Calculates the new position of a particle applying Verlet physics based on acceleration and previous state.

methods.name: resolveCollisionWithBounds
methods.description: Clamps particle position within defined bounds to simulate constraints.
